recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. No core follow-up is needed unless the project decides to move this extension back into the core build; any future content correction for this extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack repository.
issue_request: FHIR-29572 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking for textual container closure system description content on Medication.Batch. The accepted resolution was to create a core extension for the attribute.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in core before this reconciliation through the Medication manufacturing batch extension rather than by changing the base Medication resource. The pre-removal core source contained StructureDefinition/medication-manufacturingBatch with context Medication.batch and a container.closureSystemDescription slice of type string; git history shows the related source row was corrected from closureSystem/code wording to closureSystemDescription/string wording in ca02776c429524d547a3683403ae7f71e940a2fa.
additional_context: FHIR core later removed extension definitions from the R5 source in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0, including source/medication/structuredefinition-extension-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml and the corresponding Medication IG resource entry. The current core checkout only retains the OID registration for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/medication-manufacturingBatch, while the current FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains the active medication-manufacturingBatch StructureDefinition under input/definitions/multiple and its IG includes input/definitions/* as build resources.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because the requested closureSystemDescription extension is present in the Extension Pack source with context Medication.batch, cardinality 0..1, value type string, and the Jira-requested container closure system definition.
